name: Dance Club
body:
Aura moderate enchantment; CL 11; Weight 3 lbs.; Price 35,500 gp

DESCRIPTION

Some dance clubs are fancy and stylish, others look like something a shaman might carry. In either case, they are decorated with symbols of dance and music. When this +1 club strikes a critical hit the target must make a Will save (DC 22) or be affected by an irresistible dance spell for 1d4+1 rounds. If they save they are affected for only 1 round.

Anyone possessing this club also gains a +4 enhancement bonus to their Perform (dance) skill checks.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells irresistible dance; Cost 17,750 gp
